'''Bless''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': -1

'''Sanity Cost''': 2

'''Upkeep Phase''': You may cast and discard to choose one [[investigator]] (even yourself).  That investigator is [[Blessed]].
